card.name: Filter pore size numbers
card.fires_on: The space, decimal point or digit right before a micron or micrometer size value, mostly after filter wording such as 'porosity' or 'pore size'. It also appears for particle or organism sizes.

modes.label: Filter porosity
modes.description: The slot just after 'porosity' or 'pore size' where a filter's micron value comes next.

modes.label: Inside size numbers
modes.description: The decimal point or digit within a micron-scale value such as 0.2 or 1.2.
modes.example: with an infusion set with an in-line, sterile, non-pyrogenic, low-protein-binding filter (pore size of 1.<<2>> μm or less).
